draft.emotion: wide-eyed and taken aback by something unexpected happening right now
notes: Past participle of 'şaşırmak' (to be surprised; to get confused), often used with verbs like 'görünmek' (to look) or 'bakmak' (to look at). 'Şaşkın' is a very common near-synonym.
